plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, PLTU, METU, MSFU, MUU) to zero.
Reduce QQQI holding to 20% to lower concentration.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation by cutting high-risk assets.
It aims for lower drawdowns and a steadier, less volatile portfolio.
A significant cash buffer will be maintained.
conservative.read: This mode focuses on capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% per month. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also slower growth potential. Significant cash holdings will buffer against market downturns.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (METU, MSFU, SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to small positions.
Reduce QQQI holding to 25% to manage concentration.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.
It aims for steady growth with controlled drawdowns.
A moderate cash buffer will be kept.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% per month, prioritizing risk management while seeking growth. It reduces leverage and concentration, blending broad market exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to reduce income concentration.
Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (METU, MSFU, SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to 6% each.
This plan aggressively pursues growth by increasing leverage and concentration.
Expect higher potential returns but also significantly larger drawdowns.
Leveraged ETF decay and rebalancing are key risks to monitor.
aggressive.read: This aggressive mode targets around 4% per month, aiming for maximum growth through increased leverage and concentration in high-potential assets. Be aware that this significantly raises the risk of large drawdowns and rapid losses due to leverage and ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MSFU, MUU, SPAL, PLTU) to zero.
Increase QQQI holding to 30% to maximize income generation.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income over capital appreciation.
It aims for low drawdowns and reliable distributions.
A cash buffer will be maintained to support income generation.
income.read: This income-focused mode targets around 1% per month, prioritizing consistent monthly distributions. It shifts away from growth and leverage towards income-generating assets like QQQI. While aiming for low drawdowns, the Net Asset Value (NAV) can still decline in market selloffs, and distributions are not guaranteed.
